body:
Fun Clan, anyone is welcomed and I hope you guys enjoy being here. We have a few members already in it, I'll list them below, if I haven't mentioned you, or you want to join, say you want to join.

Note: It isnt a tourney clan, it is a fun clan. We may join tourneys here and there, but only the best pvpers and best players of the clan will participate in such activities. Other than this, everyone is welcomed to enjoy activities with us!
